edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire total supply to the untrusted msg.sender.
renounceOwnership authorizes via _msgSender() derived from msg.sender.
transferOwnership authorizes via _msgSender() derived from msg.sender.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
block.timestamp is emitted in the OwnerForcedSwapBack event.
block.timestamp is passed as the buyback swap deadline.
tx.origin keys the transfer delay mapping and block tracking in _transfer.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written per tx.origin to rate-limit transfers.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy/sell classification for fees and limits.
_isExcludedFromFees is read to bypass trading gate and fee taking.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount is read to bypass max amount and max wallet checks.
maxTransactionAmount bounds buy and sell amounts.
maxWallet bounds recipient balance.
gasPriceLimit is compared against tx.gasprice for AMM buys.
swapping flag guards nested swapBack execution during _transfer.
tokensForDev1 is incremented with the dev1 share of fees.
tokensForMarketing is incremented with the marketing share of buy fees.
buyTotalDevFees is used to compute the buy fee.
sellTotalDevFees is used to compute the sell fee.
tokensForDev1 is read, zeroed and converted to ETH in swapBack.
tokensForMarketing is read, zeroed and converted to ETH in swapBack.
marketingWallet receives its ETH share via low-level call in swapBack.
Dev wallets receive ETH shares via low-level calls in swapBack.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for the router and pair.
Constructor calls setAutomatedMarketMakerPair for the created pair.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract, dead address and marketing.
Constructor creates the Uniswap pair and stores it in uniswapV2Pair.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter after the pair guard.
Internal setter writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exclusion mapping.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
enableTrading sets tradingActive and swapEnabled under onlyOwner.
removeLimits disables limitsInEffect, gas limit and transfer delay.
disableTransferDelay clears the transferDelayEnabled flag.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount within bounds.
updateMaxAmount writes maxTransactionAmount after a lower bound check.
updateSwapEnabled toggles the swapEnabled flag.
renounceOwnership sets the owner storage to address zero.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner storage slot.
_transfer invokes swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer sets and clears the swapping guard around swapBack.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth for the accumulated tokens.
swapBack performs low-level ETH transfers to dev and marketing wallets.
swapTokensForEth invokes the Uniswap router swap with zero min output.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH with zero minimums.
forceSwapBack calls swapBack when contract balance exceeds 1% of supply.
buyBackTokens invokes the router ETH-to-token swap.
buyBackTokens constructs the WETH to token path array.
_transfer computes fees and token shares via mul/div arithmetic.
swapBack computes pro-rata ETH shares via mul/div arithmetic.
ETH transfer to a contract wallet can execute fallback code and reenter _transfer.
Wallet fallback during swapBack ETH distribution can reenter the contract's transfer/swap logic.
Untrusted recipient fallback invoked from the buyback ETH value transfer can reenter token logic.

normalization_plan.reason: param_from is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful inside its dataflow.
param_to is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful inside its dataflow.
param_amount is a parameter of _transfer adjusted by fee arithmetic.
param_tokenAmount is the token amount consumed by swapTokensForEth.
param_ethAmount is the ETH value supplied to addLiquidity.
param_newAmount is the input of updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
param_newNum is the input of updateMaxAmount.
param_updAds is the address input of excludeFromMaxTransaction.
param_isEx is the boolean input of excludeFromMaxTransaction.
param_enabled is the input of updateSwapEnabled.
param_account is the address input of excludeFromFees.
param_excluded is the boolean input of excludeFromFees.
param_pair flows into the internal AMM pair setter.
param_value flows into the internal AMM pair setter.
param_ethAmountInWei is the ETH amount spent by buyBackTokens.
param_newOwner is the address written by transferOwnership.
local_contractTokenBalance is an intermediate balance cache inside _transfer.
local_canSwap is a control decision local inside _transfer.
local_takeFee is a control decision local inside _transfer.
local_fees is the computed fee transferred by _transfer.
local_contractBalance is an intermediate balance cache inside swapBack.
local_totalTokensToSwap aggregates obligations inside swapBack.
local_ethBalance is the ETH pool used for distribution inside swapBack.
local_path is the router path array built for swapTokensForEth.
